## 14. Design Decisions

The DES numbers are stable identifiers cited from other documents; they need not be contiguous. This table is the definition of every DES; the area files (`5.NN-<slug>.md`) hold the detailed contracts and cite the DES. A superseded decision keeps its row and starts with the ID that replaced it.
